title: Burning activity calendar for one region or drawn area
description: Producer: P3 (pipeline/harmonize) for whole regions; P4 (backend) for drawn areas. One entry per year-month. Counts are in 'active fire cell-days' (H3 res-7 hexes with >=1 detection per day).

area_label.description: Optional label for a user-drawn area

baseline_years.description: Complete years used for median/IQR (anomaly baseline), e.g. [2001, 2025]

modis_raw.description: Raw MODIS cell-days (Terra+Aqua), null if no MODIS

viirs_raw.description: Raw VIIRS cell-days from the reference satellite for that month, null before 2012

harmonized.description: Value on the common scale. What the calendar shows by default.

is_estimated.description: True when converted from MODIS (no VIIRS that month)

is_nrt.description: True when based on near-real-time (not yet standard) data

median_m.description: Median of harmonized for this calendar month over baseline_years

iqr_m.description: Interquartile range for this calendar month over baseline_years

anomaly_z.description: IQR Anomaly Score: (harmonized - median_m) / max(iqr_m, 1.0). Never call it sigma.

source.description: Which satellite record the harmonized value comes from

peak_event.description: Optional dominant fire cluster in this month for NASA GIBS before/after imagery comparison

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] padded cluster bounding box in degrees
